questions.text: A campus platform is split into registration, fees and results areas. What is registration called?
questions.explanation:
A subsystem is a meaningful smaller part of a larger system.

Why: Subsystem matches this question.

Example: Registration can work with fees without being the entire platform.

Student note: A subsystem is a logical division, not necessarily one source file.
